verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a JSON-only REST API and no long-term contracts. That makes the API a developer building block for scripting data retrieval and the contract terms an adjacent ease-of-leaving point. Neither is a documented data-export capability. Nothing in the pack describes a bulk or full-account export in open formats, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
